phases.name: Discovery → Testable Contracts
phases.scope: Актуализировать traceability, ownership Order/CustomerAccount/Invoice; разграничить signed и proposed BR; согласовать с реальными ролями W1..W5. Описать Gherkin Given/When/Then для приоритетных сценариев, включая негативные, конкуренцию и отключение внешних интеграций.
code: ADR для агрегатов и transactional boundaries
AC cards/BR signoff ledger with reviewer + date + evidence
tests: documentation JSON validation, uniqueness and cross-reference
negative-case coverage mapping (not executable business acceptance)
phases.gate: Для каждого функционального среза — подтверждённые actor/resource scope, бизнес-владелец, AC, отказ и legal/finance signoff, где необходим; не подписанный BR не превращается в продуктовый allow.
phases.next: RD-01 возможен параллельно; бизнес-срезы используют только подписанные правила.

phases.name: Build + Platform Foundation
phases.scope: Проверить существующий Spring Boot 4.1.2/Java 21 error bootstrap. PoC совместимости Spring Modulith/MapStruct/Flyway/Testcontainers; добавить PostgreSQL/PostGIS test infra, Testcontainers, profiles, Secret/Connection/Application config, миграции, минимальные audit/idempotency/outbox порты и fail-closed security. Docker Compose/local smoke.
code: backend Maven BOM lock and reproducible build
CI exact SHA; issue/artifact refs; readme
tests: ERR-* existing contract regression on current SHA
ApplicationModules.verify no cycles/internal imports
DB migration, startup and rollback/no phantom outbox
RLS fail-closed + two tenant pool reuse
invalid JWT/401/403 shared ProblemDetail
phases.gate: mvn verify и startup на конкретном SHA; реальные PG/PostGIS+RLS интеграции, не H2 вместо PG; не открывать бизнес API без auth.

phases.name: Tenancy + Identity + Customer Scope
phases.scope: Tenant/LegalEntity, Member/RoleAssignment, Provider↔CustomerOrg relationship, CustomerAccount grants, PartnerGrant, invitation, verified identity, customer vs tenant employee, revoke/suspension, SoD. Разделить identity/authorization grant (Tenancy) и commercial relationship facts (Commercial).
tests: AUTH-X-* cross tenant, customer-org, delegated role escalation
deny foreign entity counts and UUID enumeration
revoke while cache warm; worker privilege revalidation
two JDBC connections and pooled tenant switch
same person with multiple roles, no self-approval
phases.gate: Два Tenant + минимум два CustomerOrg в одном provider не видят чужих записей; сквозной authorization HTTP→DB подтверждён.
phases.frontendAcceptance: Вход/выбор подтверждённого Tenant или CustomerAccount; запрет доступа к чужому кабинету и безопасная обработка истёкших приглашений.

phases.name: Commercial RFQ + Customer Inbox
phases.scope: Создать Draft RFQ, submit/clarification/qualification по принятому lifecycle; Customer My Requests и Provider Incoming RFQs. CQRS-light query ports, URL/API contracts, typed filter/sort allowlists, offset pagination, SQL indexes, tenant/customer scoping. Opt-in draft soft delete только при отдельной принятой политике; иначе скрыть недоступное действие.
code: command + query repositories, Flyway and RLS
safe SQL indexed searches + page metadata
tests: BSC-002, AUTH-EXT-*/AUTH-COM-* applicable
same-createdAt deterministic ordering, size cap, invalid sort
cross-account filtering before COUNT/OFFSET; SQL EXPLAIN
double submit changed payload conflict; draft deletion/quote issuance race if enabled
phases.gate: External customer sees only own RFQs; provider only allowed Inbox; pagination/count and DTO no leak; one logical create/submit effect.
phases.frontendAcceptance: Customer My Requests: создание/отправка RFQ, фильтры, сортировка, пагинация, empty/error states; Provider Incoming RFQs: только разрешённый inbox.

phases.name: Commercial Quote + Approvals
phases.scope: Immutable QuoteVersion/terms hash, issue/expire/supersede, price approval and SoD; independent authority to sign, version-specific customer acceptance and optional decline; never treat acceptance as confirmed booking.
code: QuoteVersion aggregate and guarded state machine
approval proof/evidence and typed domain events
tests: BR-01/02/05 TDD-SIM variants after signoff
AUTH-EXT-006, AUTH-X-005/006 as applicable
race accept/expiry/supersede, stale expectedVersion
approve own exception denied; no hidden buy rate in response
phases.gate: Only authorized exact current quote version can be accepted; never mutate issued terms; no implicit Booking.CONFIRMED.
phases.frontendAcceptance: Разные экраны просмотра и правомерного акцепта QuoteVersion; состояние awaiting resource confirmation не отображается как confirmed booking.

phases.name: Fleet + Cargo + Compliance + PostGIS
phases.scope: VehicleCombination/driver/capacity windows; CargoProfile weights, volume, dimensions and controlled eligibility; ComplianceAssessment with UNKNOWN fail-closed. PostGIS verified coordinates and proximity search; Fleet owns transactional CapacityHold, no read-model guard.
code: vehicle/cargo master repositories + geo query port
tests: BR-07, BR-08; DATA-*, GEO-* applicable
two competing reservations on separate transactions
expiry vs confirmation race; old GPS cannot authoritatively reserve
missing safety rule returns hold/needs review; no automatic allow
postgis ST_DWithin meters + cross-tenant nearest exclusion
phases.gate: No double hold in DB, no unsafe UNKNOWN release, correct coordinate/units and geo tenant isolation; real concurrency test green.
phases.frontendAcceptance: Операционный shortlist автомобилей с freshness/eligibility; UNKNOWN compliance — заблокированная кнопка с объяснением, не фиктивная автоматическая проверка.

phases.name: Booking Process + External Carrier
phases.scope: Booking.ResourcePending→Confirmed only after quote and confirmed capacity; CarrierOffer selected is not exclusive reserve. Own-fleet vs partner carrier, hold TTL, durable orchestration/recovery and cancellation before/after start with compensation.
code: carrier adapter mock with status reconciliation
booking read model and scoped endpoint
tests: TDD-R0-E2E-02/03/10 candidates
WF-001/002, SM-001..005, JOB-001..005 as applicable
crash after Fleet hold before Booking commit
carrier withdraw while confirmation races, lease fencing
retry duplicate command and process restart no double booking
phases.gate: Confirmed Booking always has valid evidence of Quote + exclusive CapacityReservation + compliance; crash/retry converges and cleans hold.
phases.frontendAcceptance: Provider/Carrier Booking workflow: hold, pending, confirmation, rejection/cancel request; при конфликте UI показывает актуальную версию после повторного чтения.

phases.name: Execution + Custody + Partial POD
phases.scope: Shipment/Trip/TransportLeg/CargoUnit, pickup/custody handover evidence, offline driver replay after revoke/reassignment, partial delivery/rejection/return with conservation; customer claims as safe exception stub without false Delivered.
code: Execution state machines and custody ledger
offline command intake with verifier and quarantine
tests: TDD-R0-E2E-04, BR-09/10 variants
online/offline pickup duplicate/out-of-order
custody conservation 8/10; cannot close 10/10
driver reassignment/revoke before offline replay, evidence quarantine
GPS and Trip.STARTED never become pickup/POD evidence
phases.gate: No custody loss or forged POD; verified cargo-unit reconciliation and negative/replay invariants pass.
phases.frontendAcceptance: Driver offline pickup/POD draft queue + receiver evidence; после устаревшей роли/assignment показать requires reconciliation, не silently delivered.

phases.name: Tracking + Documents + Query/Soft Delete Qualification
phases.scope: Event-derived customer timeline, permission-filtered milestone, ETA freshness/watermarks; verified document packages and downloads; cursor/keyset for immutable chronological streams; data lifecycle/retention/legal hold, default active lists exclude soft deleted where policy eligible.
code: cursor signer/validator keyed to scope revision + filter
tests: SDB-006, 009..016, 018..019 as applicable
DATA-08..10, GEO-05..08 conditional GPS slice
foreign tracking/cursor, stale signed URL after revoke
read model lag, backfill, out-of-order, delete tombstone replay
verified document access, legal hold blocks purge
phases.gate: No raw GPS/foreign documents, truthful freshness, no erased legal evidence, cursor cannot cross authorizations.
phases.frontendAcceptance: Customer Tracking + POD/documents, явная свежесть ETA, строгий customer-visible field allowlist, истекшая ссылка не открывает чужой документ.

phases.name: Finance-lite + Verified Settlement
phases.scope: Distinct invoice, receivable, payable, payment allocation, advance, claim references and approval; exact money/FX/tax precision; payment evidence from verified bank/ERP adapter or audited manual verification, not GPS or user toggle. Independent finance approver.
code: AR/AP read projections and privacy-filtered APIs
tests: TDD-R0-E2E-06, FIN-* and BR-11/12 cases
duplicate bank callback, amount precision, currency mismatch
approve own payment denied; no over-allocation
delivered!=paid, advanced funds!=performed service
unknown banking result reconciliation, not blind retry
phases.gate: No fictitious PAID or duplicate money effect; financial balance and independent approval verified on real PostgreSQL.
phases.frontendAcceptance: Finance office AR/AP + evidence status; approval и posting отделены, paid не доступен как произвольный ручной переключатель.

phases.name: Jobs + Resilience + Subscription Safety
phases.scope: Cross-cutting durable Job Engine, outbox/inbox, retry classification/dead letter, fencing, observability, error catalog consistency. Subscription suspension during live cargo follows BR-04 with explicit safety continuity; do not build full SaaS Control billing in R0.
code: PostgreSQL-backed durable jobs and reclaim supervisor
outage modes and safety continuity adapter
tests: JOB-001..008 / WF-* and NEG-R0-ASYN* applicable
worker dies after effect before ack; duplicate callback
expired lease stale attempt cannot commit
revocation, fallback, cache/Redis outage fail safe
R0-E2E-07 subscription suspended but POD/custody guarded
phases.gate: No lost committed event or job, no duplicate logical effect, no cross-tenant worker privilege, operable degraded state.
phases.frontendAcceptance: Состояния долгой операции, retry/failed, graceful degradation и безопасная операционная непрерывность при недоступности внешних сервисов.

phases.name: R0 Full E2E + Recovery + Performance
phases.scope: Reproduce full route two tenants + two customer accounts + external carrier + driver + receiver. Include all accepted applicable 84 TDD and 48 negative scenarios by traceability, not merely test count. Fault injection, CI exact SHA, migrations, backup/restore, partition test conditional GPS and load benchmark.
code: smoke runner and CI jobs with reports
load/perf script with p95/p99 and EXPLAIN
backup/restore and data integrity/tenant isolation checklist
tests: TDD-R0-E2E-01..10 when accepted
SDB-001..020 applicability and exclusions recorded
AUTH/NEG-R0*/JOB/SM/WF, DB and Outbox assertions
two independent DB sessions plus network failure matrix
restore persisted facts and document checksums
phases.gate: Every accepted P0 applicable contract green on exact SHA, zero known P0 leak/dup booking/custody/finance bug, documented SLO from measured benchmark; no mock-only release claim.
phases.frontendAcceptance: Сквозная browser/UI и при необходимости offline device simulation: customer→provider→carrier→driver→receiver→finance, все негативные видимые состояния.

phases.name: Pilot Acceptance + Release Qualification
phases.scope: Business/legal/finance signoff for applicable BR and corresponding user journeys; selected KZ road corridor/ordinary cargo, supported deployment profiles. Release image SBOM, secret scan, rollback/runbook, tenant/customer onboarding, incident process, measurable pilot KPIs.
code: versioned release manifest and exact SHA test attestation
pilot handoff and business acceptance report
tests: repeat E2E on release artifact and production-like database
restore drill + data/PII retention review
sanitized audit and monitoring alert exercise
manual user walkthrough for customer/forwarder/carrier/receiver/finance
phases.gate: Signed business/legal/finance acceptance where required, exact release SHA artifacts/CI green, operational recovery proved; otherwise NO RELEASE.
phases.next: Enable RX work by measured demand.
phases.frontendAcceptance: User acceptance workshop, accessibility/responsive baseline и документирование наблюдаемых ограничений перед публикацией.

phases.name: R1 Operations Extensions
phases.scope: Rescue/cross-dock/warehouse ledger, subscriptions and billing; each as small TDD vertical with domain ownership and multi-tenant security, never automatic full stack at once.
tests: custody transfer, warehouse conservation, billing control, cancellation compensation
phases.gate: New module tests + regression R0 all green, measured business value.

phases.name: R1/R2 Optimization + Intelligence
phases.scope: Optimization jobs and ML history separated: approved data lineage, point-in-time features, model version, source provenance; workers optional after workload evidence.
tests: reproducible datasets, no cross tenant training leak
solver outputs never bypass mandatory compliance and booking guards
phases.gate: Use-case benefit/quality/latency and tenant security verified; fallback deterministic.

phases.name: R2+ Market / Regulations
phases.scope: Private load board then optional public freight marketplace, country-specific authoritative rules and typed standards only with licensing/expert signoff; no unverified eCMR/customs guarantees.
tests: fraud/disclosure negative cases, no booking ownership leakage
rule version rollback, unknown jurisdiction fail closed
phases.gate: Separate business/legal/regulatory acceptance and R0 regression.

prChecklist: all impacted BR review status known
RED test committed or test evidence justified
DB migrations reversible or expand/contract safe
no deleted evidence hidden by soft delete
